scope: Local Jazzy/Harmonic simulation and read-only adapter. A passive Pi probe succeeded earlier on 2026-10-31 (real camera topics), but the Pi was unreachable again at 17:02Z; no Pi deployment or Pi recording was completed. Do not treat local results as hardware evidence.

refused.control/base: 403 readonly hardware mode does not accept actuator commands
refused.expert: 403 scripted expert is disabled in hardware_readonly mode

read_only_agent.note: The ROS graph still has publishers for actuator topics from the simulation agent/watchdog; the read-only node itself publishes none.
read_only_agent.preview_backend: pillow in test; OpenCV fallback added for camera-only images
read_only_agent.refusal_detail: all responses are read_only_mode; none reaches a ROS publisher or service

upper_sync.export_detail: only simulation sessions with action/feedback can be exported for training

raspberry_pi.ssh: connect to host 192.168.19.138 port 22: Connection timed out (BatchMode, no credentials exposed)
raspberry_pi.status: blocked; real camera, real bag, Pi deployment and Pi disconnect test remain unverified

local_network_at_1711Z.state: UP but NO-CARRIER; ethtool Link detected: no
local_network_at_1711Z.meaning: The host is no longer on the Pi wired subnet; this is a physical link/power/network state, not a Pi ROS conclusion.
local_network_at_1711Z.wifi_subnet_ssh_scan: 192.168.31.0/24 port 22: no hosts answered (0.4s connect timeout); does not prove the Pi is absent behind a firewall

pi_passive_observation.container: MentorPi, ros:humble, Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.10.12, host network

sensor_topics_confirmed.odom: /odom (~30 Hz), /odom_raw (~47 Hz command integration, not encoder odometry)
sensor_topics_confirmed.joint_states: /joint_states (~20 Hz), /controller_manager/joint_states (~46.8 Hz; servo state is target cache, not verified encoder feedback)

pi_passive_observation.mcap: no MCAP plugin visible; sqlite3 plugin visible
pi_passive_observation.clock: Pi wall clock about 2026-04-08 while workstation was 2026-10-31; not synchronized; do not align cross-host wall times
not_done: no web consumption of real camera

hardware_readonly_profile.caveat: camera extrinsics/optical transform and arm/gripper feedback remain unverified; profile refuses training export
hardware_readonly_profile.capacity_note: Pi root ~8.7 GiB free; 2 GiB safety margin retained.

required_stream_missing.method: read-only agent + synthetic sensor publisher; publisher killed mid-session
required_stream_missing.note: Session manifest records error and no READY; partial raw and logs retained.

disk_low.note: No bag process was started; session directory/events retained for diagnosis.

mcap_startup_regression.observed: old startup check required a non-empty bag file and rejected a healthy zero-byte MCAP at start
mcap_startup_regression.fixed: existence of a bag_* file plus a live recorder is the readiness signal; stop re-validates with ros2 bag info
mcap_startup_regression.verified: subsequent sessions reached raw_ready and bag info reported messages

mid_session_disk_low.method: SessionRecorder with a fake bag process; min_free_bytes raised after start

deployment.target: existing container MentorPi; no system install; SSH auth delegated to user config
deployment.check_result: SSH connect timeout; script exited 1 with "Pi is not reachable via SSH; no remote changes made."

export_cancel.method: real sleep process registered as export job; POST-like export_cancel called

web_stale_state.after_publisher_stop: age_s>=5.9, stale=true; UI shows 画面过期 and 无新图像 5.904 s，仍显示最后一帧
web_stale_state.status: verified in browser snapshot; image is a local synthetic test topic, not a real camera

preview_congestion.method: 32 persistent slow /preview.mjpg clients held open before and during a read-only recording
preview_congestion.interpretation: Preview backpressure did not stall the ROS bag recorder; raw recording remained independent.

passive_probe_rehearsal.note: Receiver-side rates are Python probe rates, not native driver rates. On Pi run inside the container with default /ascamera topics.

hardware_profile_rehearsal.topics_source: synthetic Pi-like publisher using the real /ascamera topic names, 640x400 bgr8, CameraInfo
hardware_profile_rehearsal.note: This validates the Pi profile and sqlite3 path locally; it is not real Pi camera evidence.

hardware_profile_upper_disconnect.note: Upper backend killed while a Pi-profile sqlite3 session was recording; agent finished locally.

bridge_readonly_race.bug: new upper backend treated a read-only agent as controllable before its first /status poll
bridge_readonly_race.fix: agent_token_required lazily refreshes /status when no status has been observed
bridge_readonly_race.verified: start-session succeeded through a freshly started backend without control token

preview_backend_fallback.method: agent started with a meta-path blocker making PIL unimportable; OpenCV 5.0 available
preview_backend_fallback.note: Confirms the camera-only Pi image can preview without Pillow; real Pi dependency presence is checked by deploy --check.

sync_integrity_tests.tampered_ready: rejected as READY manifest hash mismatch

recording_stats.purpose: Mesured counts and receiver/bag-derived Hz now travel in session.json and manifest.json without synthesizing missing data.

truth_recording_throttle.problem: Gazebo PosePublisher ignored update_rate; task truth topics were ~907-909 Hz and dominated message count.
truth_recording_throttle.fix: agent republishes raw truth at 20 Hz to /lelab/recording/{cube,container,box}_pose; expert/evaluation still use original truth topics.
truth_recording_throttle.note: Bag bytes remain dominated by uncompressed 640x480 RGB; message overhead and truth topic flood are reduced.

clock_jump_guard.policy: hardware_readonly stops the bag on >1s backward or >5s+2*elapsed forward jump; no READY

export_alignment_fix.problem: first exported frame could predate the first available observation/action
export_alignment_fix.fix: start at max(episode start, first image/state/base stamp, first applied action time); original start retained as started_time_ns
export_alignment_fix.note: No future observations or synthetic actions were introduced.
